title: Once Upon a Time in Gielinor: Foreshadowing
start: Speak to Relomia in the Blue Moon Inn in Varrock.

recommended.t: Activated Draynor lodestone or unlocked the War's Retreat Teleport

steps.t: Talk to Relomia at the Blue Moon Inn in Varrock. [Chat: Accept]
Take a drink from the party table. [Chat: ~]
Drink the punch and wear the party hat.
Relomia will then tell stories of your adventures. In order to end the dialogue and progress choose the correct statement about the quests.
Talk to Relomia again. [Chat: 3 It was a wooden stake › 3 It wasn't called Blacklight! › 4 It had one head, not three!]
Unequip the party hat as this will save time by skipping some dialogue.
Enter the Closure's Study, the door to the east of Death's office.

sub.t: If you cannot interact with the door, go back to the lobby and log back in.

p: Elvarg and Delrith are waiting in line.

steps.t: Talk to Delrith. [Chat: 3 Carlem. › 1 Aber. › 2 Camerinthum. › 5 Purchai. › 4 Gabindo.]
Talk to Count Draynor directly to the east.
Talk to Elvarg for the Last Will and Testament.
Head to the kitchen in the northwest corner of the floor 1 of Draynor Manor and turn off the range.
Talk to a banker (e.g Varrock west / east bank, Varrock Grand Exchange, Draynor) to receive Elvarg's treasure hoard from the Last Will and Testament.

sub.t: Certain bankers will not work (e.g Taverly south-western bank)

p: Count Draynor is waiting in line.

steps.t: Return to the Closure's Study in Death's office.
Talk to Closure to the north.
Re-equip the party hat and speak to Relomia in the Blue Moon Inn. [Chat: 3 Hello, [player name]. › 4 I'm [player name]'s biggest fan! › 3 Can I get your autograph?]

sub.t: The party hat can be taken from the table again in case you destroyed it.
